verdict.rationale: Datacenter-scale training and serving is a fair axis for a GPU, but the evidence documents no NVLink or other high-bandwidth GPU-to-GPU interconnect, no multi-GPU system configurations, and no rack-scale deployment for the RTX 5090. The pack only covers single-card specs (32GB GDDR7, PCIe 5.0, Tensor Core precisions), CUDA tooling and gaming features, none of which deliver the multi-GPU or rack-scale story.
